statements.t: The Company assumed BLF’s 2022 Stock Incentive Plan in the Merger, and no further awards will be granted under that plan.

We also intend to use a portion of the net proceeds to pursue a quotation of our Common Stock on an over-the-counter market or a listing on a national securities exchange, and for working capital, capital expenditures and other general corporate purposes.
We intend to apply the net proceeds as described under “The Offering - Use of Proceeds” above.
We have based this estimate on assumptions that may prove to be wrong, and we could exhaust our available capital resources sooner than we expect.

We will require substantial additional funding to complete development of our pulsed laser and fusion energy technologies and to commercialize any resulting products, and we may seek such funding through equity or debt financings, government contracts and grants, or strategic collaborations.
We do not anticipate that our status as an “emerging growth company” will be impacted by the Merger.
